models.name: Motif 3 (Baekpica Mixed-Quant GGUF) — UNOFFICIAL, experimental
models.weight_dtype_or_quant: Mixed GGUF: attention/GDLA/output-gate Q8_0 + BF16/F32 (1273 F32, 318 BF16, 543 Q8_0), experts IQ2_XXS(102)+Q2_K(51). 2287 tensors.
models.gpu_requirements: ds4-dfm resident model/runtime measured 91.26 GiB on ONE device -> fits a SINGLE RTX PRO 6000 (96GB) at limited (~32K) context; 256K needs ~128GB unified (DGX Spark). Single-GPU runtime: no documented 2-GPU split, so the 2nd card is unused.
models.recommended_engine: ds4-dfm (Baekpica/ds4 @ dfm branch, tag v0.6.2-dfm, commit a09ff4f) — custom C/CUDA runtime with native Motif binder + OpenAI Chat/Completions/Responses + Anthropic server. NOT llama.cpp, NOT vLLM.
models.chat_template: Native Motif tokenizer/chat/reasoning/tool protocol implemented in ds4-dfm (validated).
models.tool_calling: yes — card documents validated OpenAI-compatible tool-call + result-loop (MQ87-88-FIT-SAMPLE-VERIFY.json, H200-OPENAI-32K-CORRECTNESS).
models.compatibility_notes: Quant quality strong (Q2_K down cosine 0.9996, combined sparse output cosine 0.9998, logit cosine 0.995, top-8 overlap 8/8) — far better preservation than uniform IQ2. BUT the ds4-dfm CUDA objects are built for sm_121a (DGX Spark GB10) and sm_90 (H200) ONLY; our GPUs are sm_120 (a DIFFERENT Blackwell target). Vendor's own cross-build audit says the sm_121a objects 'cannot be executed' off GB10. Needs a from-source rebuild of ds4 for sm_120 (CUDA 13 present; MXFP4/DS4_CUDA_HAVE_MXF4 supported on RTX PRO 6000) — UNVERIFIED by vendor on sm_120.
models.blocking_issues: PRIMARY BLOCKER: ds4-dfm must be rebuilt for sm_120 from pinned source; vendor validated only sm_121a(GB10)/sm_90(H200), single-GPU unified-memory design. Feasibility on 2x discrete 96GB cards unproven. Download NOT started (per instruction). If pursued: build ds4@v0.6.2-dfm for sm_120 FIRST, prove it serves, THEN fetch the 94GB. Explicitly an UNOFFICIAL mixed-quant checkpoint.
